name: Firefoot
subtitle: Éomer's Steed
game_text:
Bearer must be a <culture>Rohan</culture> Man.
At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert.
<phase>Regroup</phase>: If bearer is Éomer, exert him to discard a condition. Any Shadow player may remove <twilight>1</twilight> to prevent this.
